This is a good choice if you’re looking for a more traditional, highly produced indoor haunted-house experience. The Darkness also features a horror retail store, monster photo opportunities, a serial-killer escape room and other Halloween entertainment.

### 2026 Schedule

The Darkness is open on select nights from September through November.

October hours include:

  * October 2–3: 7:00–10:30 p.m.
  * October 9–10: 7:00–10:30 p.m.
  * October 16–17: 6:45–11:30 p.m.
  * October 23–24: 6:30–11:30 p.m.
  * October 30–31: 6:30–11:30 p.m.
  * Select Sundays and weeknights are also available.
  * Additional November dates are scheduled through November 13.

Halloween night — Saturday, October 31 — runs until 11:30 p.m.

### 2026 Ticket Information

General admission is listed at $34.95, with Speed Pass, Immediate Access and combination-ticket options available. The Darkness and Creepyworld can also be purchased together as a combo.

Worth knowing: The Darkness warns that the attraction includes strobe lights, fog, low visibility, moving floors, damp/wet conditions and other physically demanding effects. Read the attraction’s safety information before bringing younger children or anyone with medical conditions that could be affected by those effects.


October hours include:

  * October 2–3: 7:00–10:30 p.m.
  * October 9–10: 7:00–10:30 p.m.
  * October 16–17: 6:45–11:30 p.m.
  * October 23–24: 6:30–11:30 p.m.
  * October 30–31: 6:30–11:30 p.m.
  * Select Sundays and weeknights are also scheduled.

There are also November dates, including November 1, November 7 and November 13.

### 2026 Ticket Information

General admission is currently listed at $34.95. Speed Pass, Immediate Access and combo tickets with The Darkness are also available. The haunted hayride is an additional $5. Parking is listed at $5.

Dad tip: If you’re going with kids or people who aren’t huge horror fans, remember that Creepyworld is a lot of Halloween. You’re walking around an outdoor screampark rather than simply spending 20 minutes inside one haunted house.

# 🍺 Lemp Brewery Haunted House

📍 3500 Lemp Avenue, St. Louis, MO 63118

Official Website — Lemp Haunted House

There’s something particularly creepy about going underground into an old brewery at night.

### VIP Terror Pass

Includes front-of-line access, your choice of interactive experience, a VIP gift and VIP lanyard.

The attraction requires waivers from all participants, and tickets are valid on any open night during the 2026 season through November 1.

Important: This is probably not the haunt I’d choose for a casual family Halloween night. Read the descriptions carefully before purchasing, especially if you’re bringing teenagers.

# 🌲 The Hollows Haunted Experience at Brookdale Farms

📍 8004 Twin River Road, Eureka, MO 63025

Official Website — The Hollows at Brookdale Farms

This is one I’ve personally been keeping an eye on because The Hollows has become a really fun St. Louis-area Halloween experience, particularly for families with older kids and teenagers.

And in 2026, Brookdale Farms has made it bigger.

The Hollows is an outdoor haunted trail through the woods and portions of the farm’s corn maze, featuring live actors, fog, special effects and themed scenes inspired by Old West legends.

For 2026, the trail has been expanded with four new scenes:

  * The Camp
  * The Graveyard
  * Fighting Dead
  * Ghost Town

Brookdale Farms says the experience takes approximately 50 minutes to an hour, depending on your pace.

### 2026 Tickets

  * Presale: $20
  * General/day-of online: $25
  * Gate: $30
  * Four-person bundle: $80

Parking is free, and food and drinks are available onsite.

### 2026 Hours

The Hollows begins with the first entry at dark, with the last entry at 10:45 p.m. Ticket sales end one hour before closing.

The attraction is scheduled on multiple October nights, including Halloween night, Saturday, October 31, from 7 p.m. until midnight.

### A note for parents

Guests under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.

The Hollows also involves uneven outdoor terrain, fog, strobe lights, loud noises and sudden scares. Wagons and strollers aren’t permitted.

And if you recognize the description of this haunt from somewhere, you might be remembering a previous StLouisDad visit. We took three kids through The Hollows — ages 10–15 — and they had a blast. That’s one reason I’m particularly interested in seeing what the expanded 2026 version is like.

## Plan the evening

Dates and crowdsHalloween 2026 falls on a Saturday. The Darkness and Creepyworld both run Friday, October 30 and Saturday, October 31 from 6:30 to 11:30 p.m., and the Alton Halloween Parade starts at 7 p.m. on October 31, so expect Halloween weekend to be the busiest of the season. Several family events end before Halloween: Grant's Farm and Boo at the Zoo both close their seasons on October 30. Jack's Lighted Trail stays open through Sunday, November 1, including Halloween night. Clocks go back one hour at 2 a.m. on Sunday, November 1.

Getting aroundThe attractions are spread across the metro. The Darkness is in Soulard near downtown, City Museum is downtown, Boo at the Zoo is in Forest Park and Grant's Farm is in south St. Louis County. Creepyworld is in Fenton, which the operator puts about 20 minutes from downtown. Fright Fest, The Hollows and Brookdale Farms are farther southwest in Eureka, and Hell Harvest in Potosi is about 65 miles southwest. On the Illinois side, Alton, Godfrey and Grafton are to the north and Belleville and Millstadt are to the east. Plan one area per evening.

Six Flags renamedSix Flags St. Louis no longer uses that name. The Eureka park was renamed on August 27, 2026 , and now operates as Mid America Adventure under Enchanted Parks. Fright Fest keeps its name for 2026, so look for tickets and hours under Mid America Adventure.

Costumes and masksCostume and age rules are set by each venue. The Darkness, Creepyworld and Hell Harvest do not allow costumes. At Fright Fest, adults may not wear costumes, and children 12 and younger may wear them without masks. Boo at the Zoo does not allow guests 14 and older to wear masks or face paint that hide the whole face, and it does not allow scary costumes. The Darkness and Creepyworld have no minimum age, but teens under 17 need a parent present or proof of an immediate ride home.

### Dark Hollows Haunted Hike

A Scout camp haunted hike with hot chocolate

When
    Fridays and Saturdays, October 16 to 24

Where
    Camp Big Timber, Elgin

The Boy Scouts of America Three Fires Council runs this 45-minute haunted walk through the Hollows at Camp Big Timber. Afterward, guests gather at a fire pit with hot chocolate and snacks.

See details and booking notes Hide details and booking notes

#### Before you book

Tickets are sold online only. Wear comfortable, closed-toe shoes. Start times are not posted on the organizer's page, so check them on the ticket page.
